newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: To be limited in return to practice
newsAll.body: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Daniels (elbow) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: Making trip to London
newsAll.body: Daniels (elbow) is traveling with the Commanders to London ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

newsAll.head: Rico Dowdle: Remains listed as DNP
newsAll.body: Dowdle (toe) was estimated as a non-participant on Tuesday's injury report, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

newsAll.head: Jaylen Waddle: Considered OK despite boot
newsAll.body: Waddle is believed to be "fine" despite being seen wearing a walking boot on his right foot following Sunday's victory over the Rams, Sam Jane of The Denver Post reports.

newsAll.head: Rico Dowdle: Spectator for Tuesday's practice
newsAll.body: Dowdle (toe) was present for Tuesday's practice but was a non-participant, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.
